action_needed.summary: Critical updates detected that may affect account verification or risk status.

review_recommended.summary: Noteworthy updates observed. Review during the next customer contact.

no_material_change.summary: Customer details remain consistent with previous records.

could_not_verify.summary: Today's check could not reach the website or retrieve sufficient details.

registration_number.label: Company Registration
registration_number.why_it_matters: A change in registered company number indicates a possible corporate restructuring, change of legal entity, or change of ownership that requires statutory verification.
registration_number.recommended_action: Request updated corporate documentation or official registrar extract before processing account changes.

legal_entity.label: Legal Entity Name
legal_entity.why_it_matters: A modification in legal entity or corporate designation directly affects account mandates, invoicing, and legal agreements.
legal_entity.recommended_action: Obtain updated certificate of incorporation and refresh client verification documents.

rebrand.label: Brand / Trading Name
rebrand.why_it_matters: A new trading name affects payment routing, brand identity, and anti-fraud naming checks.
rebrand.recommended_action: Confirm registered trade names with the business owner and update account trading aliases.

office_relocated.label: Operating Address
office_relocated.why_it_matters: Relocation alters geographic risk ratings, jurisdiction, and legal notice delivery.
office_relocated.recommended_action: Obtain current proof of address (such as a utility invoice or registered office filing) prior to record update.

address.label: Business Address
address.why_it_matters: Physical location adjustments impact compliance jurisdiction and operational risk profile.
address.recommended_action: Request proof of address to confirm new premises.

phone.label: Telephone Number
phone.why_it_matters: Telephone numbers serve as primary verification channels. Unannounced changes may present communication or fraud risks.
phone.recommended_action: Execute callback verification using previously authorized contact numbers before changing bank records.

email.label: Email Address
email.why_it_matters: Email addresses are used for transactional notices and account authentication. Unverified changes increase security risks.
email.recommended_action: Send confirmation request through authorized secondary channels.

domain_redirect.label: Website Redirection
domain_redirect.why_it_matters: The company website redirects to an alternate domain, which can signal a corporate merger, rebranding, or domain lapse.
domain_redirect.recommended_action: Verify domain ownership and whether banking relationships extend to the destination domain.

site_down.label: Website Availability
site_down.why_it_matters: The site is unreachable or displays connection failures, which may indicate operational disruption or trading cessation.
site_down.recommended_action: Reach out to the relationship team and evaluate recent transaction velocity.

site_parked.label: Parked Domain
site_parked.why_it_matters: The website shows a placeholder or domain-for-sale notice, indicating the business may have ceased online operations.
site_parked.recommended_action: Initiate an urgent account review to determine business trading continuity.

catalog_expanded.label: Commercial Catalog Offerings
catalog_expanded.why_it_matters: Significant expansion in product or service offerings may indicate diversification or expansion into new business sectors.
catalog_expanded.recommended_action: Record changes in relationship notes for upcoming periodic review.

subdomain.label: Connected Web Platform
subdomain.why_it_matters: New client portals or login platforms indicate expanded digital operations.
subdomain.recommended_action: Note newly identified client platform in relationship file.

description.label: Business Summary
description.why_it_matters: Updates to business summary reflect evolving market positioning or product scope.
description.recommended_action: Keep for background information during periodic account reviews.

general.label: General Profile Detail
general.why_it_matters: Informational adjustment reflecting public website maintenance.
general.recommended_action: Save to client file for future reference.

reasons.legal_suffix: Standard corporate designation update (e.g., Ltd, Inc)
reasons.baseline_stale_meta: Routine website refresh with consistent core content
